info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在培養學生具備機器視覺系統整合與影像處理能力，熟悉 OpenCV 應用與感測器校正技巧，能實作視覺伺服控制與影像辨識追蹤系統。同時介紹移動機器人之架構、導航與環境感知，並透過 ROS 平台進行 SLAM、定位與路徑規劃開發，奠定智慧製造與自主機器人應用基礎。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to develop students’ abilities in machine vision system integration and image processing. Students will learn to apply OpenCV and sensor calibration techniques for visual servo control and object tracking. The course also covers mobile robot architecture, navigation, and perception. Through ROS-based SLAM, localization, and path planning projects, students will gain practical experience for intelligent manufacturing and autonomous robotics applications.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生應用人工智慧於工業問題分析與解決之能力，能將理論轉化為實務。
targets.describe_en: To cultivate students’ ability to apply AI techniques to analyze and solve industrial problems, bridging theory and practice.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生熟悉AI模型建構、資料前處理與特徵分析流程，建立完整問題導向思維。
targets.describe_en: To enable students to understand AI model development, data preprocessing, and feature analysis with problem-oriented thinking.

targets.describe_ch: 透過專題實作強化團隊協作與專案管理能力，並能有效整合跨領域知識。
targets.describe_en: To strengthen teamwork and project management skills through hands-on industrial AI projects, integrating interdisciplinary knowledge.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生以倫理與社會責任觀點評估AI技術於工業應用之影響。
targets.describe_en: To foster students’ awareness of ethics and social responsibility when evaluating AI applications in industry.
